meta.name: pi-goal
meta.description: Persistent Codex-style goal tracking for pi. Use when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, audit, pause, resume, complete, or inspect a long-running goal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让助手持续跟踪长期目标，可随时查看和调整进度。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你希望让AI助手记住并持续推进你的长期目标。
copy.tagline_en: Keep your assistant on track with long-term goals, pause or resume anytime.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI assistant to remember and keep working on multi-step goals.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以创建、查看和更新持久目标。只有确认全部完成时才能把目标标为「完成」;暂停、恢复、预算限制等操作由 /goal 命令控制。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求设置、继续、审计、暂停、恢复、完成或检查长期目标时触发。

say.text: 创建一个目标:完成 pi-goal 扩展,预算 50000 token。
say.note: 创建后 Claude 会记录目标并开始跟踪。

say.text: 查看当前有哪些目标及进度。
say.note: Claude 会调用 get_goal 展示当前目标状态。

say.text: 将目标「完成 pi-goal 扩展」标记为完成。
say.note: 按规则 Claude 会先审计是否真的全部完成。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can create, view, and update persistent goals. It can mark a goal complete only after confirming all work is done; pause, resume, budget limits, and clearing are handled by the /goal command.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user explicitly asks to set, continue, audit, pause, resume, complete, or inspect a long-running goal.

say_en.text: Create a goal: ship the pi-goal extension with a budget of 50000 tokens.
say_en.note: Claude records the goal and starts tracking it.

say_en.text: Show the current goals and their progress.
say_en.note: Claude calls get_goal to display goal status.

say_en.text: Mark the goal 'ship pi-goal extension' as complete.
say_en.note: Claude audits actual completion before marking done.
